c6254d487ee7.title: Operations Strategy Analyst
c6254d487ee7.description:
Handle Recruitment is looking for a highly organised and driven Operations Strategy Analyst to provide analytical and project support to the Operations Strategy team at our client's growing sports business.
 £35,000 to £40,000 based on experience 
 London Based | Hybrid - 3 Days In Office 
 The Client 
Our client is not your typical sports organisation. They are a global sports business, co-owned by professional athletes, with a mission to celebrate and elevate triathlon like never before.
2026 marks an exciting new chapter. Following the acquisition of Challenge Family and a strategic partnership with World Triathlon, they are expanding their global reach and creating a more connected future for the sport.
Looking ahead to 2027, the organisation is focused on delivering an even bigger global event portfolio, elevating the athlete and fan experience, and establishing triathlon as a truly global sports and entertainment property.
 This is a rare opportunity to join a high-performing, high-energy and values-driven team, with leadership talent from UFC, RFU, Uber, Meta, ATP and Formula 1, all passionate about building something extraordinary.
 The Role 
You'll dive deep into data, identify bottlenecks and help turn high-level strategy into actionable, day-to-day improvements. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys getting hands-on with data to understand the "why" behind the "what".
You'll contribute to ambitious, industry-defining projects, learn through experimentation and help shape the future of triathlon within a fast-paced, growing organisation.
Reporting to the Business Strategy Associate, the role is based at our client's London HQ.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Strategic Support 
 Lead specific strategic projects, such as developing pricing strategies for new events, from data gathering through to the final product.
 Turn one-off operational tasks into standardised, repeatable processes and documentation.
 Maintain performance dashboards covering revenue, cost optimisation and efficiency metrics.
 Analyse operational data to identify trends, opportunities and red flags.
 Support high-quality presentations and reports for senior and executive audiences, translating data into clear charts and visualisations.
 Conduct benchmarking and market research against competitors, industry standards and best practices.
 Project Coordination 
 Act as the "drumbeat" for strategic initiatives, keeping project trackers updated and deadlines on track.
 Support the Business Strategy Associate in coordinating with departments to gather requirements and maintain project alignment.
 Map current-state versus ideal-state processes to identify opportunities for improvement.
 About You 
 1-2 years' experience in an analytical role such as Operations, Consulting or Strategy, ideally within sports or events.
 Excellent attention to detail and strong analytical skills.
 Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills, including Lookups, Pivot Tables and basic modelling.
 Familiarity with Google Slides and presenting data clearly.
 The ability to turn complex tasks into simple, actionable updates.
 Natural curiosity and a willingness to ask "why" and "how".
 A proactive, get-things-done mentality, with a focus on identifying solutions, not just problems.
 The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift.
 A collaborative approach and desire to support shared goals.
 An awareness of industry trends and emerging technologies.
 What Our Client Offers 
 The opportunity to make a genuine impact within triathlon and contribute to an ambitious, growing organisation.
 A flat, collaborative and get-things-done working environment.
 Private health insurance through Vitality, including wellness benefits.
 Learning & Development budget for courses, books, events and more.
 25 days' holiday plus a Christmas break.
 Flexible working structure.
 Enhanced parental leave.
 Company share option scheme, giving employees the opportunity to share in the company's success.
 Complimentary / discounted event entries for employees, friends and family.
 Free office snacks and drinks, open water swim credits and more.
 Apply below today if you feel you have the relevant skillset! 
 Handle actively welcomes applicants from under-represented backgrounds - we pride ourselves on attracting the best talent for every opportunity through a commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion.

3ec10de7c7f7.title: Data Management Analyst
3ec10de7c7f7.description:
Job Title: Data Management Analyst
 Location: Leatherhead
 Salary: £28,000 per year
 Job Type: Permanent, Full Time
 We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Data Management Analyst to support the effective management, accuracy, and integrity of data across our business systems and processes.
 The role will work across meter data, billing, market systems, CRM, reporting, and financial processes. You will be responsible for reviewing and maintaining data, identifying discrepancies, supporting the resolution of queries, and ensuring information is accurate and managed in line with business processes.
 This role would suit someone who enjoys working with data, has a methodical approach, and is looking to develop their analytical and data management skills within a supportive and collaborative environment.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Review and maintain meter reading data, ensuring information is accurate and up to date.
 Review AMR readings and assist with checking back-end configuration settings.
 Review billing information and support the investigation and resolution of billing queries.
 Help maintain data quality and consistency between market systems, internal billing systems, and CRM.
 Identify discrepancies within data and systems and raise these for further investigation where appropriate.
 Support the maintenance of engineer route scheduling, ensuring information is kept accurate and current.
 Maintain and collate data for regular reporting requirements.
 Assist with preparing and updating reports and spreadsheets.
 Support financial reconciliation activities and help investigate differences or discrepancies.
 Maintain accurate documentation, records, and supporting information.
 Carry out regular data checks to identify missing, inconsistent, or inaccurate information.
 Follow established processes and procedures to ensure data is managed consistently.
 Work with colleagues across the business to support the resolution of data, billing, and operational queries.
 Develop a good understanding of the systems and processes relevant to the role.
 Contribute to improving the accuracy and efficiency of data management processes.
 Undertake other tasks and responsibilities as required to support business needs.
 Skills & Experience: 
 Essential; 
 Comfortable working with data and spreadsheets.
 Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, filtering, sorting, and data manipulation.
 Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
 Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to work.
 Analytical mindset with an interest in investigating and understanding data.
 Good organisational and time-management skills.
 Ability to manage your own workload and prioritise tasks effectively.
 Good written and verbal communication skills.
 Ability to follow processes accurately while using initiative where appropriate.
 Willingness to learn new systems, processes, and analytical techniques.
 Desirable; 
 Previous experience working with data, finance, administration, billing, or business operations.
 Experience using Excel to manage or analyse information.
 Familiarity with CRM, billing, or other business systems.
 Experience working with reports or reconciliations.
 Exposure to utility, meter, or market data.
 Personal Attributes: 
 Detail-oriented: takes pride in producing accurate and reliable work.
 Analytical: enjoys looking into information and understanding why discrepancies occur.
 Organised: able to manage multiple tasks and keep information up to date.
 Proactive: willing to raise questions or issues when something does not look right.
 Self-motivated: able to work effectively and maintain productivity when in a remote environment.
 Collaborative: communicates well with colleagues and is comfortable asking for information or support when needed.
 Adaptable: able to learn new systems and processes and respond to changing business requirements.
 Keen to develop: interested in building knowledge and experience across data management, finance, billing, and business systems.
 Hybrid Working: 
 This is a hybrid role, with employees able to work from home for up to two days per week and attend our Head Office in Leatherhead for the remaining working days, subject to business requirements.
 The successful candidate will be comfortable working both independently and as part of a team, maintaining effective communication with colleagues across the business. You will be expected to manage your workload efficiently, meet agreed deadlines, and maintain a high standard of accuracy and professionalism, with support and guidance available when required.
 What the Role Offers: 
 The role provides the opportunity to develop practical experience across data management, financial processes, billing, reporting, market systems, and CRM, while building confidence and knowledge within a professional business environment.
 Please click APPLY to send your CV for this role.
 Candidates with experience of; Data Management Analyst, Data Analyst, Data Quality Analyst, Data Integrity Analyst, Data Operations Analyst, Data Administration Analyst, Data Management Assistant, Data Administrator, Data Quality Coordinator, Data Analyst Assistant, Junior Data Analyst, Business Data Analyst may also be considered for this role.

Capco’s Associate Consulting Programme (ACP) is designed for early-career professionals looking to begin a consulting career within Financial Services. As an Associate Consultant, you will join a cohort of new consultants and complete a structured training programme before working on real client projects.
 You will be aligned to a core domain: Banking & Payments, Capital Markets, Insurance, or Wealth & Asset Management, gaining exposure to transformation initiatives and AI-enabled ways of working. Working alongside experienced consultants, you will help clients modernise platforms, improve operations, and respond to an evolving industry landscape.

Elixirr International plc is a global consulting firm with a bold ambition: to become the best consulting firm in the world.

 **Experience working in the insurance sector is ESSENTIAL** 
 Your new company 
A growing insurance business is seeking an Assistant Management Accountant to join its London finance team. The organisation operates within the specialist insurance market and provides solutions across a diverse range of commercial risks. Following continued growth, the business is strengthening its finance function to support increasing reporting requirements, maintain robust financial controls and provide high-quality management information. This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing organisation and gain broad exposure across insurance accounting, financial reporting, data analysis and business partnering and get the opportunity to work with some of the best names in the industry!
 Your new role 
As Assistant Management Accountant, you will work closely with the Finance Manager and wider business to deliver accurate and timely financial information. The role will have a strong focus on management reporting, insurance data validation and business partnering with underwriting, claims and other operational stakeholders. You will gain exposure to a broad range of finance activities, making this an excellent opportunity for a part-qualified accountant who is looking to develop their technical insurance accounting experience within a growing business.
 Key responsibilities will include: 
 Preparing management information covering premiums, commissions, claims and other key financial performance measures.
 Extracting and analysing information from underwriting, claims and reserving systems.
 Reviewing insurance data to ensure information is complete, accurate and consistent with the relevant contracts and supporting documentation.
 Analysing paid and outstanding claims information and investigating potential anomalies within financial and operational data.
 Partnering with underwriting, claims and operational teams to respond to queries and provide meaningful financial insight.
 Preparing and posting non-technical expense journals, ensuring entries are accurate and supported by appropriate documentation.
 Supporting the month-end close process, including general ledger and trial balance activities.
 Assisting with the preparation of monthly profit and loss accounts and balance sheets across multiple business areas.
 Producing performance analysis to support commercial, underwriting and claims-related decision-making.
 Developing and maintaining financial dashboards and key performance indicators for internal stakeholders.
 Supporting the preparation of statutory accounts, regulatory reporting and tax-related submissions.
 Assisting with premium, claims and commission reporting for external insurance partners.
 Contributing to financial process improvements, automation initiatives and wider financial transformation projects.
 Supporting ad hoc reporting, analysis and project work as required.
 What you'll need to succeed 
 Part-qualified status through ACCA, CIMA or ACA, with a commitment to completing your professional qualification and actively studying towards completion. 
 ****Previous accounting experience gained within the insurance sector**** 
 A good understanding of insurance accounting principles and financial reporting requirements.t.
 An understanding of insurance and reinsurance arrangements and how premiums, commissions and claims are recorded.
 Experience preparing management accounts, management information or financial performance reporting.
 Strong analytical skills and the ability to identify inconsistencies or anomalies within large volumes of data.
 Strong attention to detail and the ability to work accurately within reporting deadlines.
 What you'll get in return 
 Permanent opportunity within the specialist insurance market.
 Hybrid working arrangement.
 Exposure to management accounting, insurance reporting and commercial finance.
 The opportunity to work closely with underwriting, claims and operational stakeholders.
 Broad exposure across multiple areas of the finance function.
 Supportive environment for a part-qualified accountant looking to continue their professional development.
 The chance to contribute to process automation and finance transformation initiatives.
 Excellent long-term development opportunities within a growing business.

 Responsibilities 
 Onboard and off-board clients for ICE Data Derivatives products and services
 Field client inquiries and requests received via email, Chat, Sales Force, and phone, including, but not limited to, product and application questions, as well as data and price confirmations
 Provide timely and accurate response to all client inquiries
 Provide support for any file delivery failures
 Escalate issues with internal groups to resolve issues with urgency, when applicable
 Maintain strong relationships with clients and internal teams
 Ensure up-to-date documentation of policies, procedures and work processes periodically
 Knowledge and Experience 
 Bachelor's or equivalent university degree is preferable
 Excellent verbal and written English language skills
 Excellent time-management and organizations skills
 Experience in a similar support or client-facing role (an advantage)
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and follow-up
 Ability to interact with external clients, as well as internal business units
 Working knowledge of SalesForce, Service Now, MS Office, FTP (an advantage.) 
 Schedule 
This role requires 5 days a week in office attendance Monday to Friday from 8am and/or various morning start times. Evening shifts are usually from 12pm to 20:00 in the office. All other shifts are 9 hours. Currently there is a requirement to work 1 later shift per week from 12:00 to 20:00. Exceptionally this role will provide holiday and sickness cover for ICE Data Derivatives overseas offices as required, which may include an evening or night shift (including Friday evening/night).

c3199b790fe7.description:
About Man Group 
 Man Group is a global alternative investment management firm focused on pursuing outperformance for sophisticated clients via our Systematic, Discretionary and Solutions offerings. Powered by talent and advanced technology, our single and multi-manager investment strategies are underpinned by deep research and span public and private markets, across all major asset classes, with a significant focus on alternatives. Man Group takes a partnership approach to working with clients, establishing deep connections and creating tailored solutions to meet their investment goals and those of the millions of retirees and savers they represent.
 Headquartered in London, we manage $253.6 billion* and operate across multiple offices globally. Man Group plc is listed on the London Stock Exchange under the ticker EMG.LN and is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index. Further information can be found at 
 At Man Group, we respect your privacy and we are committed to protecting and safeguarding your Personal Data. We have developed policies and processes which are designed to provide for the security and integrity of your Personal Data. We are committed to Processing your Personal Data fairly and lawfully, and being open and transparent about such Processing. For further information on how we process your data, please see the privacy notice for applicants 
 * As at 30 June 2026
 About Man Central Trading 
 Man Central Trading is a global team of more than 50 traders, execution researchers and engineers operating across multiple offices. Our mission is to maximise the preservation of alpha throughout the investment process by delivering execution excellence and trading specialisation.
 We combine deep market expertise, rigorous execution research and best-in-class technology to trade effectively across asset classes and market environments.
 Man Central Trading is at the forefront of applying artificial intelligence to trading and execution. The team operates at the intersection of high-touch and quant trading, combining traders’ market expertise with systematic research and AI-driven tools.
 Our open, collaborative and fast-paced culture makes Man Central Trading an ideal place to learn and develop. The team offers a unique vantage point across Man Group, providing insight into a broad range of investment strategies and trading approaches.
 Central Trading Internship 
 This 12-week internship offers the opportunity to work directly on the trading desk and gain first-hand exposure to the role of execution within the investment process.
 The intern will work across a broad range of asset classes and trading styles. This will include exposure to discretionary trading and systematic trading across equities, credit, futures and other macro instruments.
 Sitting at the intersection of high-touch and quant trading, the intern will help bridge the two approaches by contributing to the development and improvement of AI trading capabilities. They will work on projects exploring how artificial intelligence can improve trading decisions, execution processes and the desk’s overall trading capabilities.
 The role will provide significant exposure to trading, market microstructure and Man Group’s investment engines, including Man AHL and Man Numeric within Man Systematic, as well as Man Discretionary.
 Responsibilities 
 - Work alongside traders and quant traders on the Central Trading desk.
 - Help develop and improve AI and quant-trading tools and workflows.
 - Analyse market and proprietary trading data to identify execution improvements.
 - Build an understanding of market microstructure across asset classes.
 - Collaborate with Man Group’s systematic and discretionary investment teams.
 - Communicate research findings and recommendations clearly.
 Who Are We Looking For? 
 We are looking for candidates with a strong mathematical and analytical background who are comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment. Successful candidates will be intellectually curious, able to learn and iterate quickly, and confident communicating with a wide range of stakeholders.
 Candidates should be on track to achieve at least a 2:1 degree in a STEM-based or similarly quantitative subject.
 Key Skills and Experience 
 - Strong background in mathematics, statistics and machine learning.
 - Experience coding in Python.
 - Ability to work and iterate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
 - Strong interpersonal skills and confidence working with multiple countparrties
 - Interest in financial markets, quant trading and market microstructure.
 - Interest in artificial intelligence, including experience with or an interest in LLM-based workflows.
 - Entrepreneurial team player, able to challenge and discuss ideas constructively and contribute to the wider Central Trading team.
 Please note that we are looking for penultimate year university students for this programme, and successful performance on the Internship Programme does not guarantee a confirmed place on a Graduate Programme. 
 Application Process 
 Application Window: 28th September - 12th October
 Online Tests: October
 Technical Interviews: October/November
 Assessment Centre: November/December – Please note that candidates will be required to attend the assessment centre at our London Office.
 Programme Dates: 21 st June 2027 – 10 th September 2027 
 Inclusion, Work-Life Balance and Benefits at Man Group 
You'll thrive in our working environment that champions equality of opportunity. Your unique perspective will contribute to our success, joining a workplace where inclusion is fundamental and deeply embedded in our culture and values. Through our external and internal initiatives, partnerships and programmes, you'll find opportunities to grow, develop your talents, and help foster an inclusive environment for all across our firm and industry. Learn more at .
You'll have opportunities to make a difference through our charitable and global initiatives, while advancing your career through professional development, and with flexible working arrangements available too. Like all our people, you'll receive two annual 'Mankind' days of paid leave for community volunteering.

3927a30eee0a.description:
Discover what's possible for your future with Macquarie. Join Commodities and Global Markets (CGM) as a Summer Intern and gain experience in one of Macquarie's core businesses. You'll build technical skills, learn from industry experts, and contribute to work that helps clients manage risk, unlock capital and pursue opportunities across global markets. 
We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you're empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future. 
 What role will you play? 
As a Summer Intern in Commodities and Global Markets, you'll support your team on real work while gaining practical experience of a global business that combines deep industry expertise with entrepreneurial thinking. You'll learn from professionals ranging from geologists and meteorologists to engineers, data scientists, quant strategists, traders and advisers, and develop the technical skills, confidence and networks that can support your future career. 
You'll work closely with your team to support clients through tailored solutions across commodities, financial markets and asset finance, gaining insight into how we help clients navigate challenges and identify opportunities in global markets. 
Our opportunities span a range of teams across Commodities and Global Market s including : 
 Quant Strategy , where you could help maintain and develop quantitative platforms and implement quantitative methods. 
 Quantitative Investment Strategies Marketing , where you could support strategy development and explanation, client mapping, marketing and outreach. 
 Business Operational Risk Management , where you could investigate incidents, support remediation and help assess the effectiveness of business controls. 
 Quantitative Investment Solutions and Structuring , where you could apply creative problem-solving to quantitative models, systems and solutions for institutional clients. 
 Non-Financial Regulatory Reporting , where you could analyse transaction reporting data, i nvestigate reporting issues and support regulatory, process and technology change. 
 Depending on your individual role, you could be: analysing market, client, risk or regulatory data 
 developing quantitative methods, models, tools or platforms 
 translating complex financial or technical concepts into clear explanations 
 investigating issues, identifying root causes and supporting remediation 
 contributing to improvements in processes, systems and controls 
 supporting client engagement, strategy communication and outreach 
 collaborating with colleagues across trading, risk, technology, operations and other specialist teams. 
 Your nine-week programme will start with a tailored induction week providing you with the skills and knowledge we think you need to be successful. 
As part of this programme, you'll : h ave the opportunity to gain insight into the financial services industry and build the technical skills and knowledge that will help you discover more for your career 
 g ain valuable experience and insight into your chosen business area,working closely withyourteam 
 w ork side-by-side with business leaders andhave the chance tocollaborateon live projects and transactions from day one 
 g eton-the-job experience and hands-on training to help set you up for a successful career once you complete your studies. 
 What you offer 
You have a unique perspective. We want to hear it. We welcome applications from students in their penultimate year of study of an undergraduate or master's degree, or students undertaking a final year undergraduate degree and planning to continue to a master's degree, graduating in January to July 2028. You are studying a discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, engineering, economics, finance or another quantitative field of study. 
 You approach problems in a structured and creative way, have strong numerical skills and can communicate complex or technical information clearly. 
 You like to collaborate with others , are comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and can adapt as priorities change . 
 You have an interest in financial services and bring a proactive, resourceful and positive attitude, as well as a strong work ethic. 
 You are curious and eager to learn, including developing your understanding of complex products, systems or regulations, and contribute to real business outcomes . 
 You have strong attention to detail and are comfortable working with data and using relevant analytical tools . 
 For some of our quantitative opportunities, experience using Python will be important , while familiarity with AI tools, data analysis or automation may also be advantageous , depending on the team. 
 We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply. 
 Inclusion at Macquarie 
We are committed to providing an inclusive environment for all, where different experiences, skills and perspectives are valued and respected. Macquarie provides access to opportunities for all individuals regardless of their identity, including age, disability, neurodiversity, gender (including gender identity or expression), sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy, parental status, race (including ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, or socio-economic background. 
We provide reasonable adjustments to individuals who may need support during the recruitment process and employment. If you require an adjustment, please let us know during the application process.

cc69f33894bc.location: Cambridge, Cambridgeshire, England, United Kingdom; London, United Kingdom Cambridge, United Kingdom, London, United Kingdom
cc69f33894bc.description:
About Charles River Associates 
 Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.
 About the Internship     
 CRA’s Life Sciences Practice helps pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical devices and digital health companies achieve optimum performance across key aspects of their business including commercial strategy, pricing and access, innovation, organisation structure, policy analysis, medical affairs, stakeholder management, and reputation, all for the long-term benefit of patients, clinicians, employees, and shareholders. We work with life sciences businesses directly as well as with their legal counsel, industry associations, government organisations, and advocacy groups.
 The CRA Life Sciences team operates from offices across the United States, UK and Europe, providing insights on global issues and local market challenges across all geographies.    
 Our clients’ trust in us is rooted in our emphatic focus on clients and specifically our hands-on life sciences experience, in-depth sector knowledge, from R&D to market entry and beyond, and strong academic credentials in science, economics, policy and business.     
 Our dedicated Policy team works with Life Sciences companies, industry associations, government organizations, and advocacy groups to anticipate and respond to policy challenges. Our projects focus on analysing ongoing or anticipated policy challenges, assessing the impact on patients, competition or innovation, and helping clients with developing solutions that address these challenges whilst supporting their commercial priorities.     
 During your internship you may work on a variety of project types, including but not limited to:     
 Policy projects: helps clients anticipate how healthcare policies will evolve and what this means for access to medicines and future innovation. Projects range from US debates on drug pricing and Medicare negotiations to global challenges around cell and gene therapies, healthcare financing, and digital health   
 Opportunity assessment : Supporting the valuation of new therapies     
 Value communication : Building evidence-based narratives to demonstrate the clinical and economic value of new medicines     
 Market access planning & payer strategy : Mapping regulatory pathways, evidence needs, reimbursement hurdles and innovative solutions across geographies     
 Forecasting & pricing strategy : Developing models to project product performance, define the optimal launch and lifecycle price of a therapy, inform launch planning activities     
 Commercial strategy & lifecycle planning : Designing go-to-market models and strategies to sustain brand value and portfolio planning      
 Joining the Life Sciences Practice at CRA over the summer will provide you with a unique opportunity to develop your knowledge of global healthcare. Our Summer Internship program mirrors the analyst experience: you will be treated as an analyst from day one. You will join project teams working on high-impact challenges in life sciences, with opportunities to learn, contribute, and grow.    
 You can expect to:    
 Work closely with senior colleagues on strategy and policy projects that address real client needs    
 Conduct research and analyse both qualitative insights and quantitative data    
 Contribute your ideas to team discussions and see how your analysis feeds into client deliverables    
 Attend client meetings and expert interviews, gaining exposure to real-world stakeholder perspectives    
 Draft sections of reports, presentations, and Excel models, supported by senior team members    
 Develop your knowledge of the life sciences industry and consulting methodologies    
 Take part in training and practice-building activities    
 Alongside this project work, you will have a Professional Development Manager dedicated to your growth, an onboarding buddy for day-to-day support, and regular feedback from project managers    
 Desired Qualifications     
 Penultimate year or final year Bachelor’s, Master’s or PhD degree candidates with strong academic performance from a top-tier institution (minimum 2:1) with focused study in biological sciences, economics (or related subjects including business, health economics and policy, public policy), physical sciences, mathematics, statistics, engineering, or other STEM discipline;    
 Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Outlook and Excel), plus an understanding of how to conduct internet research    
 Proficiency using and analysing quantitative data to answer questions;    
 Experience with, or keen interest in, Life Sciences industry and healthcare;    
 Understanding of economic concepts and business processes, as well as familiarity with essential consulting methodologies, tools and techniques;    
 Effective written and oral communication and presentation skills (additional languages beyond English are helpful);    
 Strong self-management (detail orientation, effective time management, ability to prioritise);    
 Demonstrated high level of initiative and leadership;    
 Excellent teamwork and collaboration capabilities;    
 Clear and demonstrated interest in consulting through coursework, work experience, activities, or attendance at CRA recruiting events;    
 Willingness and ability to undertake occasional travel to clients if required.   
 To Apply     
 Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis starting from 2 October 2026 . We will begin inviting candidates for video interviews from 16 November 2026 onwards. We strongly encourage early applications, as interview slots will be offered on a first-come, first-served basis, and will close applications once the positions are filled.     
 To be considered for this position, please submit the following:    
 Resume/CV: please include current address, personal email and telephone number;    
 Cover letter:   please describe your interest in CRA and how this role matches your goals. Your cover letter should be no more than one page, and presented in a clear, professional manner (minimum font size 12).  Please ensure your cover letter answers the following questions:    
 Why life sciences consulting, and why CRA?    
 What is an example of a time when you made a data-guided decision?    
 Which experience from your resume/CV are you most proud of and why?    
 The internship will take place from Monday 28 th June 2027 – Friday 3 rd September 2027.   
 Professional Development      
 CRA’s robust skills development programs and wellness programming encourage you to thrive as an individual and team member. We provide interns a variety of technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and performance coaching over the summer.    
 Work Location Flexibility 
 CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognise that individuals realise a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently ask that individuals spend 3 to 4 days a week on average working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to a client's location), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.
 Our Commitment to Diversity 
 Charles River Associates is an Equality Act 2010 employer. As part of our focus on equity and inclusion, we work to en

6-month Contract | London | Hybrid Working 35 Hours per Week
Are you an experienced Senior Administrator or Personal Assistant looking to make a meaningful impact within a national charity and progress into an Executive Assistant role? We are seeking a highly organised, proactive and confident Executive Assistant to provide dedicated support to two Directors in a complex and fast-paced environment. Acting as a trusted gatekeeper, you will manage competing priorities, build strong stakeholder relationships and ensure senior leaders have the information and support they need to operate effectively.
The Role
As Executive Assistant, you will provide high-level support to the People & Culture Director and the Finance & Technology Director. You will play a pivotal role in maximising their effectiveness through exceptional organisation, communication and stakeholder management, including taking accurate minutes, providing comprehensive administrative support, diary management, and meeting coordination. We are looking for someone who can quickly build strong relationships, work with minimal supervision, and make an immediate positive impact within the team.
Key Responsibilities
 Manage complex diaries, schedules and competing priorities, ensuring Executive Directors are focused on strategic objectives.
 Act as a trusted gatekeeper and first point of contact, exercising discretion, professionalism and sound judgement at all times.
 Coordinate meetings, agendas, papers and follow-up actions to ensure effective governance and decision-making.
 Build and maintain strong working relationships with senior stakeholders across the organisation and externally.
 Arrange travel, accommodation and logistics for Executive Directors as required.
 Prepare presentations, reports, briefing papers, research and correspondence to support senior leadership activities.
 Proactively anticipate needs, resolve issues and provide seamless administrative support in a fast-paced environment.
The ideal candidate will have:
 Previous experience supporting senior leaders within a public sector organisation
 Exceptional organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines effectively.
 Outstanding diary management and coordination experience.
 Strong stakeholder management skills and the confidence to build relationships at all levels.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a high level of attention to detail.
 The ability to anticipate needs, solve problems independently and make sound decisions.
 A proactive, solutions-focused approach with excellent judgement and discretion.
 Strong administrative and coordination skills, with the ability to manage confidential information professionally.

4df92372a185.title: Executive Assistant
4df92372a185.description:
Location : Remote, with a requirement to be in central London once a week. Please note, you will only be considered if you are within a commutable distance to London.
 Hours: Full-time, 35hrs per week, 9am to 5pm
 Salary: Upto £35,000
 THE COMPANY 
 Our client is a rapidly growing healthcare company who supports people with addiction. They are going from strength to strength and have built a strong reputation within its sector and is now scaling its operations, team, and client base. As growth accelerates, the Founder needs a highly organised, proactive right hand to keep the business running smoothly and to free up their time for strategic growth activity. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a business at an exciting stage of its journey, with genuine scope to shape the role and your experience as the company evolves.
 ROLE PURPOSE 
 The Executive Assistant will provide comprehensive personal and administrative support to the founder, while also taking ownership of day-to-day operational processes across the business. This is a remote role combining traditional PA duties - diary and inbox management, and correspondence - with broader operations responsibilities such as liaising with marketing, supplier coordination, office management, process improvement, and light project support. The successful candidate will be a natural organiser who thrives in a fast-paced, ever-changing small business environment and is comfortable working across multiple priorities at once.
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Diary & Inbox Management: Managing complex diaries, scheduling meetings, and resolving clashes across multiple stakeholders
 Email & Correspondence: Acting as a first point of contact and gatekeeper for the leadership team, prioritising and drafting correspondence
 Marketing Coordination: Working with the marketing team to bring to life marketing initiatives
 Meeting Support: Preparing agendas, taking minutes, and tracking follow-up actions for leadership and board meetings
 Office & Operations Management: Overseeing day-to-day office operations, supplier relationships, and facilities to keep the business running smoothly
 Finance Administration: Assisting with invoicing, expense processing, and basic budget tracking alongside the finance function
 HR & On-boarding Support: Supporting recruitment coordination, on-boarding, and general HR administration as the team grows
 Process Improvement: Identifying opportunities to streamline administrative and operational processes as the business scales
 Project Support: Providing ad hoc project support across the business, from event coordination to research tasks
 Confidentiality: Handling sensitive business and personal information with absolute discretion
 SKILLS & EXPERIENCE - ESSENTIAL 
 Experience: Proven experience in a PA, EA, Office Manager, or Operations support role, ideally within a small or scaling business (Min 3 years)
 Organisation: Exceptional organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and tight deadlines
 Communication: Confident, professional communicator, comfortable liaising with senior stakeholders and external contacts
 Proactive : Hands-on approach with the initiative to anticipate needs before being asked
 IT Literacy: Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office / Google Workspace; comfortable picking up new systems quickly
 Adaptability: Calm and adaptable under pressure, with the resilience to work in a fast-changing small business environment
 Discretion: High level of discretion and sound judgement when handling confidential information
 PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES 
 Hands-On Attitude: A genuine team player who is willing to roll up their sleeves across a broad and varied role
 Interpersonal Skills: Warm and approachable, building trusted relationships across the business
 Growth Mindset: Excited by the opportunity to grow within the role as the business scales
 Attention to Detail: Meticulous attention to detail across all areas of work
 If you are looking for an exciting opportunity to be part of a successful growing organisation, with huge scope to grow - this could be your next role! When you apply, please ensure your location is marked clearly on your CV. Whilst this position is remote based, you will need to be within commutable distance to the City of London.
 Please note, only those with full rights to work in the UK will be considered for this role. This role does not offer sponsorship.

6de99a87b8bf.title: Executive Assistant (Executive Office)
6de99a87b8bf.description:
Job Title – Executive Assistant (Executive Office) 
 Salary – from £43,033 per annum 
 Contract Type – Permanent, full-time (35 hours) 
 Location – We fully support flexible working, from our superb offices in Holborn and from home. We do require staff to spend 20% of their time in the office. This is subject to role requirements. For this role it will require 2 to 3 days in the office.
 About us 
 Do you want to change healthcare for the better? 
 Join the Royal College of Surgeons of England (RCS England) and you will be part of a professional membership organisation and registered charity that is committed to advancing surgical care. We provide world-class education, assessment and development to 30,000 surgeons and dental surgeons at all stages of their career. Our vision is to see excellent surgical care for everyone. We do this by setting professional standards, facilitating research and championing the best outcomes for patients. 
 Our heritage home in Lincoln’s Inn Fields, Holborn 
 Nestled in the heart of bustling London, our beautiful heritage building in Lincoln’s Inn Fields, Holborn, offers an easily accessible location steeped in history. Now transformed into a centre of excellence for surgery, it provides a welcoming place for all our members to train, meet or network, wherever they live and work.
 About the role 
 The Royal College of Surgeons of England is looking for an organised and proactive Executive Assistant to provide high-quality administrative and organisational support across the Executive Office. You will provide dedicated executive support to specific Officers and/or members of the Executive Director Team, as allocated, while working collaboratively and flexibly with the wider executive support team. You will help coordinate priorities, maintain effective working arrangements and act as an important liaison with internal and external stakeholders. This role requires sound judgement, professionalism and the ability to handle sensitive and confidential matters appropriately.
 Responsibilities 
 Provide dedicated and proactive executive support while working flexibly across the Executive Office to provide cover and respond to changing priorities. 
 Coordinate complex diaries, meetings, travel and associated arrangements for senior leaders supported by the Executive Office. 
 Coordinate information, papers and briefing materials for senior-level meetings, ensuring that supporting information is complete and available on time. 
 Process expenses and other routine financial administration for senior leaders and Officers in line with College procedures. 
 Provide high-quality committee support where required, including agenda coordination, minute-taking and timely follow-up of actions. 
 Act as a key point of contact for the Executive Office and build effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders. 
 Triage enquiries and requests, responding or escalating as appropriate and using discretion and sound judgement. 
 Support governance administration, meetings, groups and key forums within the Executive Office remit. 
 Coordinate agreed projects and pieces of work, maintaining plans, records and progress updates as required.
 About you 
 You will have experience of providing effective executive or senior-level administrative support in a busy environment, managing varied tasks and supporting multiple priorities. 
 You will have strong written and verbal communication skills and be able to handle sensitive and confidential matters appropriately. 
 Organised, accurate and proactive, you will be able to plan ahead, prioritise competing demands, meet tight deadlines and identify practical solutions to routine issues.
 You will be confident and professional when working with senior colleagues, Officers and College representatives, and able to build constructive relationships with internal and external stakeholders. 
 You will be able to produce accurate, well-structured correspondence, briefings, reports and presentations to a high standard. 
 You will have a high level of digital confidence, including strong working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint, together with experience of using SharePoint and Microsoft Teams to store, organise and share information. 
 You will be resilient, diplomatic and collaborative, with the ability to work independently and flexibly as well as part of a team.
 What’s in it for you? 
 27 days paid holiday + bank holidays and up to 4 college closure days over the festive period & other leave entitlements (carers leave, fertility treatment leave, etc.) 
 Hybrid and flexible working. We require staff to spend a minimum of 20% of their time in the office, subject to role requirements. 
 Enhanced contributory pension scheme 
 Equal access to enhanced parenthood leave 
 A range of staff and peer networks 
 Employee health and wellbeing committed (Healthcare cash plan, menopause friendly, disability confident employer, mental health first aiders, EAP etc.) 
 Retail discount platform 
 Sabbatical and volunteering opportunities 
 Variety of learning and development opportunities
 Interested Candidates: If you wish to apply or if you have any questions about this position please email your CV together with a cover letter to . 
 Any personal data collected from you, or that you provide to us, will be processed by us in accordance with our recruitment processes. If unsuccessful in your application, your information will be held by us on our database for a period of 6 months before deletion. If you would like your information removed sooner, please contact 
 Closing date: Friday 16 October 2026(by midday) 
 The Royal College of Surgeons of England is an Equal Opportunities Employer. We are open to all talent and we actively ensure that all qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regards to age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. The Royal College of Surgeons of England is committed to protecting your privacy. We are registered as a data controller with the Information Commissioner’s Office (ICO). All College employees are responsible for records held, created and used as part of their work for the College including patient/client, corporate and administrative records. Records are managed according to the requirements of the Data Protection Act 2018 and ensure confidentiality. The College ensures that staff are trained to handle the information you submit to us with care and discretion, seeking advice where necessary.

0c664887358e.title: Junior Quantitative Researcher - Systematic Strategies
0c664887358e.description:
London | Start by September 2026 
 We are partnering with a leading systematic investment team in London seeking an exceptional early-career Quantitative Researcher to join a high-performing, research-driven environment.
 This is a rare opportunity to work directly alongside experienced portfolio managers and researchers, contributing to live trading strategies from the outset. The team operates at the intersection of data science, financial theory, and advanced engineering, with a strong emphasis on original thinking and rigorous experimentation.
 The Opportunity 
 From day one, you will be immersed in the research lifecycle—helping to generate, test, and refine alpha signals across liquid global markets. The role is designed for individuals who combine strong academic foundations with a genuine curiosity for markets and data.
 You will:
 Develop and evaluate predictive signals using large, complex datasets
 Design and run robust backtests across multiple asset classes and time horizons
 Explore new modelling approaches, including statistical and machine learning techniques
 Work closely with senior researchers and developers to translate ideas into production
 Contribute to improving research infrastructure and data workflows
 Who They’re Looking For 
 This role targets high-potential junior talent ready to step into a front-office research environment.
 You should meet one of the following criteria: 
 A Master’s graduate (from a leading/red-brick university) with relevant internship experience in quant research, trading, or data science
 A recently completed or soon-to-complete PhD (2025 or 2026) in a highly quantitative discipline
 In addition, you will likely have: 
 Strong grounding in mathematics, statistics, physics, computer science, or a related field
 Proven programming ability (typically Python; C++ or similar is a plus)
 Experience working with data—cleaning, analysing, and extracting signal
 A methodical, research-oriented mindset with attention to detail
 A genuine interest in financial markets and systematic trading
 Why This Role 
 Direct exposure to live trading strategies from an early stage
 Highly collaborative, intellectually rigorous team culture
 Meritocratic environment where strong ideas are quickly recognised and implemented
 Clear progression into a long-term research career within systematic investing
 Additional Requirements 
 Ability to start no later than September 2026 
 Right to work in the UK (or ability to secure it quickly)

26572f82ac50.title: Trainee Junior Project Assistant - Bespoke Furniture
26572f82ac50.description:
Graduate Trainee – Bespoke Furniture – Junior Project Assistant 
 Armstrong Vinton Furniture Ltd – Parsons Green, London 
 Armstrong Vinton Furniture is looking for a Graduate Trainee who wants to build a career in the bespoke furniture and joinery industry.
 This is a two-year training programme offering practical experience across the whole business, from learning how furniture is made on the workshop floor to developing the technical and commercial skills needed to manage projects.
 The aim of the programme is to prepare you for a permanent position as a Junior Project Assistant , supporting our Project Managers with technical drawings, site surveys, CNC production, estimating, procurement and the coordination of bespoke furniture projects from design through to installation.
 You may have a relevant diploma, foundation Degree or BA (Hons), perhaps in furniture design, product design, furniture making, interiors or a related subject. More importantly, you will have a genuine interest in high-quality furniture, materials and craftsmanship, and be keen to understand how bespoke projects are designed, manufactured and delivered.
 What You’ll Learn 
 During the programme, you will gain experience in:
 Workshop practice and furniture-making techniques.
 Working alongside apprentice and experienced Cabinetmakers.
 Materials, fittings, finishes and construction methods.
 Technical drawing and draughting.
 Site surveying and setting out.
 CNC programming and production.
 Project management.
 Estimating and preparing quotations.
 Following projects from initial enquiry through to installation.
 The role will initially be based largely on the workshop floor, giving you a proper understanding of how bespoke furniture is made. As your skills develop, you will spend time with our draughting, CNC, estimating and project-management teams.
 By the end of the programme, you should have the practical knowledge and technical understanding needed to support the day-to-day running of projects as a Junior Project Assistant, with further opportunities to develop within the company.
 About You 
 We are looking for someone who:
 Has completed a relevant two-year Diploma, Degree or BA (Hons).
 Has a strong interest in bespoke furniture and joinery.
 Enjoys both practical and technical work.
 Is curious, organised and willing to learn.
 Has good attention to detail.
 Communicates confidently and works well as part of a team.
 Is comfortable using computers and interested in learning CAD and CNC software.
 Wants to develop a long-term career within the furniture industry.
 Previous workshop experience would be helpful, but it is not essential. We are more interested in your attitude, aptitude and enthusiasm for the craft.
 What We Offer: 
 A structured two-year training programme.
 Experience across every stage of a bespoke-furniture project.
 Training and mentoring from experienced Makers, Designers and Project Managers.
 The opportunity to work on high-quality residential and commercial projects.
 A clear route into a permanent Junior Project Assistant position, subject to successful completion of the programme.
 Location: Parsons Green, London
 Hours: Full-time
 Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience
 Start Date: To be agreed
 To apply, please send your CV, a short introduction explaining why you are interested in bespoke furniture, and a portfolio or examples of relevant work where available.

 📍London | 💰 £42,500 pro rata  | Data | L10 on the Data Framework 
 Data at Monzo 
 We have over 300 employees in Data at Monzo. Data is at the heart of Monzo's journey and our work defines the success and direction of the business. That means, similar to the rest of Monzo, Data too should be magically simple. 
 We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company and use data in everything we do; from machine learning models to detect and block fraudulent payments to analysing how customers use the app to improve our app design. We're great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use.
 We contribute to an open source environment as much as possible. Our blog is a good place to learn even more about what we do.
 Data Interns 
 As a Data intern at Monzo, you’ll be matched with a team where you’ll spend the summer working on a real project for our customers. 
 You’ll have the opportunity to work alongside Data teams to learn more about what Data we analyse and how we use it to solve challenges at Monzo on a day-to-day basis.
 You’ll spend your internship: 
 Learning about commercial products and how decisions using data can unlock more value for our customers
 Experimenting and utilising new data techniques to solve challenging problems 
 Turning raw data into customer stories through models, analysis and visualisations that shape our product and app design
 Understanding the nuances of our data and building the key foundational knowledge for our new products and features
 What you’ll get exposure to:  
 Python for data wrangling, analysis and building predictive solutions.  
 SQL for data modelling and gathering raw data
 Looker for data visualisation
 Spreadsheets for data analyses
 🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…  
 You are completing a degree in STEM or Computer Science with exposure to programming and are graduating in 2028
 You enjoy learning about new technologies and have a passion for problem-solving
 You are available full-time for a minimum of 12 weeks between June and September 2027, we will have two start dates in June for you to choose.
 You have the right to work in the UK without restrictions for the full 12-week internship and would not require visa sponsorship if offered a permanent position.
 You can work from our London office on a hybrid basis to collaborate with your team and mentor, as well as attend intern events over the summer
 Please note you must hold the right to work in the UK through the full duration of this internship.  
 🙌What’s in it for you 
 💰£42,500 pro rata
 📍This role will be based in our London office on a hybrid basis (2 days a week in the office)
 ⏰ We offer flexible full-time working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team 
 💻 Top-spec Macbook to use over the course of your time with us 
 🧠 Knowledge-sharing sessions with your squad and wider discipline 
 👯 Team and company wide socials / events 
 🍝 Lunch on Monzo twice a week from a range of street food vendors 
 🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps 
 Our application process involves three main stages:
 Submit your application with the short questions answered 
 If you’re successful, we’ll invite you to complete an exercise to demonstrate your programming and problem-solving skills
 If all goes well, you’ll have your final interviews with members of our data team via Google Meet
 The closing date for applications is 1st November 2026, but we encourage you to apply as soon as possible as we will be extending offers on a rolling basis.
 We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

05485738ed00.description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:



 - One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

 - Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

 - Profitable since 2017

 - Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

 - Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)



So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.



We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.




JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

 1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

 2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

 3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting




ABOUT THE ROLE



This is a 12 week internship program starting from 5th January 2027

Salary - £48,000 (per annum) 



Thinking about a move into credit? Our 3-month Credit Analyst internship is built for early-career professionals from any background who want to test-drive the role before committing to a change.

We’re looking for a someone who is great with numbers and loves problem solving to come and apply your skills in a start up environment and have a big impact on our business and how we do things.



What you'll be doing

 - Use your analytical and problem-solving skills to generate key insights from data, and use that insight to drive meaningful change in our strategy

 - Using data and modelling to ground assumptions for our NPV model, such as predicting what default rates will be in the future, and using that to inform our lending deicsions

 - Using data and analytics to drive decisions about who we should lend to, and how much we should lend to them, and how that changes with the economy and competition changes

 - Conducting hypothesis testing, and using your findings to change how we do things in areas such as lending strategy, pricing, and fraud detection

 - Presenting your findings to senior leaders in the company, then work with the product/tech team to get them implemented



What we're looking for

 - Must have coding skills in Python or SQL 

 - Someone that loves numbers! You’ll be working with numbers every single day in this role so you’ll be able to demonstrate your ability to work with complex data sets, analyse them and draw insights

 - You’ll have a natural curiosity and love to dig into things to understand how they work

 - Startup mindset. We’re a fast-growth tech startup so you’ll be super excited to work in an entrepreneurial environment and have a real impact on the business



Interview Process

 - 15-minute online test

 - Coding Take Home Task

 - Remote (video call) Task Debrief (60 mins)

 - Remote (video call) case study (60 mins)

 - In-person case study (60 min) + Culture Add Conversation (15 minutes) + a chance to meet other recent grads over lunch (30-45 minutes)




LIFE AT LENDABLE

 - Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

 - Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

 - Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

 - Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

 - Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

 - Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

 - Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

 - Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our blog https://blog.lendable.co.uk/!

ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:



 - One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

 - Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

 - Profitable since 2017

 - Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

 - Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)



So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.



We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.




JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

 1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

 2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

 3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting




ABOUT THE ROLE



At Lendable we already have a number of profitable, award winning credit products. They have a good automated quality story. However, as our customer base has grown into the millions we need to keep evolving to keep the quality bar high. Advances in AI engineering also have enabled us to ship faster, but we need to ensure we are not regressing on our quality metrics.

Our mobile app, Zable, is how most of our customers experience all of our products in one centralised space. It's written in React Native and TypeScript with a Kotlin backend, shipped to iOS and Android from a single codebase. We are now looking to level up the quality engineering so that we can raise release cadence without losing sleep over regressions.

This is an automation-first role. You'll spend most of your time writing code - test frameworks, CI tooling, helpers, rather than executing test scripts by hand. You'll work alongside software engineers, product, and design, setting direction.

You'll also be working at the frontier of AI-assisted quality, using LLMs and AI tooling to speed up test authoring, triage failures, and surface coverage gaps, while applying the engineering judgement to keep tests trustworthy.

 
 


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING




OWN THE MOBILE TEST STRATEGY:

 - Define and evolve a pragmatic test pyramid for React Native - deciding where E2E is worth the weight and where logic belongs in faster layers (Jest, React Testing Library, component tests).

 - Make deliberate calls about coverage, reliability, and speed trade-offs across the app.

 - Set the bar for what "ready to ship" looks like on mobile, and hold the line on it.
   
   


ENABLE TEAMS TO KEEP THE QUALITY BAR HIGH

 - Rotating around different product teams for short periods to level up quality

 - Define and evolve the pragmatic test pyramid for our products - deciding where E2E is worth the weight and where testing belongs in faster layers (unit and component tests)

 - Make deliberate calls about coverage, reliability, and speed trade-offs across our products

 - Devise and set up performance benchmarks to ensure critical parts of our systems don't regress

 


BRING AI TESTING INTO THE SDLC

 - Speed up our SDLC by building agents that exploratory test changes and catch issues before they get to production

 - Use AI tools day-to-day to accelerate test authoring, cluster failures, surface coverage insights, and propose fixes

 - Decide where AI adds leverage and where a human eye is needed. A test suite that looks comprehensive but isn't trustworthy is worse than a smaller one we rely on
   
   


BUILD RELIABLE E2E AUTOMATION

 - Discover gaps in testing and help teams build comprehensive suites

 - Get test environments and data fixtures to a level where they are easy to use and reliable

 - Drive flakiness down and time-to-diagnosis down. We treat a flaky test the same way we treat a broken test, and we expect root-cause work rather than retry-until-green
   
   


PREVENT DEFECTS, NOT JUST CATCH THEM

 - Partner with product and engineering on shift-left quality: join specs early, push back on ambiguous acceptance criteria, and surface risk before code is written

 - Close the loop on production issues using our observability stack (Datadog, Sentry, Grafana) - tying test coverage back to real customer impact

 - Ensure teams have Service Level Objectives set up and are achieving them

 - Run targeted exploratory testing on high-risk releases when it's the right call
   
    





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


ESSENTIAL

 - Hands-on experience with Maestro or Detox.

 - 5+ years in quality engineering or test automation, with a track record of keeping automated suites stable rather than letting them rot into a graveyard of quarantined tests

 - Experience working in a scaled engineering environment with multiple teams pulling in different directions and priorities, and know how to navigate that to drive quality improvements across them

 - Hands-on coding experience of writing test code, frameworks, CI pipelines and other helper scripts. You know what a good test codebase looks like and you constantly improve it

 - API and contract testing experience, with a point of view on test data and environment strategy

 - Have set up and used Service Level Objectives to define a contract of system reliability with stakeholders, and driven measurable improvements against them

 - Native AI-assisted working style. You can describe projects where AI meaningfully changed how you worked - test authoring, failure triage, coverage analysis - and where you decided it wasn't the right tool

 - Coaching other disciplines in quality. You evangelise quality practices and get others on board to solve quality problems together

 - Experience shaping CI/CD pipelines for test reliability (GitHub Actions or similar), including flakiness reduction, parallelisation, artefact management, and runtime control

 - Proactive, low-ego, and clear communicator, able to chase things down when blocked

 - Able to operate independently and drive improvements end-to-end (frameworks, CI, test data, reporting)

 - Can point to 3-4 projects where you moved the needle on quality - for example improving SLO coverage or reducing incident rate - and can speak to the measurable impact of each
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Hands-on experience testing React Native apps.

 - Mobile performance and reliability work (crash reporting, startup time, memory and battery awareness).

 - API and contract testing experience, with a point of view on test data and environment strategy.
   
    


OUR TECH STACK

Mobile: TypeScript, React Native, Expo, EAS, GraphQL, Relay, Jest, React Testing Library, Maestro.

Backend: Kotlin, PHP 8 (Symfony), AWS, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes.

Tooling and observability: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, Sentry, Grafana.




WHY JOIN?

 - See your work matter: Our products are used by millions of customers - the quality bar you help set has a direct line to customer trust and company revenue

 - High impact: You'll decide where and how to engage across teams to move quality forward, working hands-on rather than through process layers

 - Work at the frontier of AI: AI tooling for quality is moving fast. You'll be one of the people deciding how we apply it - what's useful, what isn't, and where to keep humans in the loop

 - An organisation that ships: No layers, no theatre, fast decisions
   
    


INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - Quick call with a Recruiter

ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:



 - One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people
